title: Page 05 complete-board to Page 33 bounded route-family test

target.description: Whether the complete source-authenticated Page 05 5x5 GP-prime board directly operates on Page 33 as a periodic key or 25-column permutation

summary: All three calibrated GP language models rejected the declared 640-route direct-board family: the selected route failed half-transfer, solved-reference, and familywise permutation gates.
why_run: To close a specific direct-key interpretation of the exact Page 05 numeric board without claiming that Page 05 or Page 33 has no other role.

pipeline.description: Verify the retained route count, input identity, calibration gates, half-transfer failures, solved-reference failures, permutation tails, and bounded rejection across all three replacement scorers.

acceptance.criterion: Every calibrated scorer rejects promotion because the independently selected half-routes differ, the observed score is below solved reference, and familywise p is greater than 0.01.

output.stdout: PASS — 16/16 retained E1477 checks; direct Page05-board to Page33 lane rejected.

controls: Each 2-, 3-, and 4-gram model recovered the planted calibration route exactly at rank 1 before Page 33 evaluation.
Each observed score was compared with solved LP1 reference text under the same model.
Each scorer used 999 seeded board permutations and the declared familywise threshold p <= 0.01.
First- and second-half routes were selected independently and required to agree.
interpretation: The complete Page 05 numeric board is not supported as a direct periodic key or 25-column permutation for Page 33 under the declared family. Address, selector, checksum, orbit, or multi-input roles remain outside this closure.
limitations: The original transient E1459 qscore dependency did not survive; the completion uses three disclosed replacement models calibrated on solved LP1 text.

The public package does not redistribute third-party corpus transcriptions, so its portable verifier audits the complete retained decision ledgers while the full route replay requires separately acquired inputs.
This does not reject every possible Page 05 to Page 33 relationship, alternate board-derived object, transform, key, or execution model.
No LP2 plaintext, key, wallet, address, onion locator, endpoint, or Page 73 preimage was recovered.

normalization_changes: Converted the historical completion into HMS Run and Result objects.
Clean-reran the frozen standalone reproduction and confirmed exact semantic agreement with the archived result.
Excluded corpus transcription files while preserving their source-package identity and the complete decision ledgers.
Added a non-mutating standard-library verifier for the retained evidence.

raw_artifacts.reason: Complete decision ledgers, report, source checksums, and reproduction source are retained; third-party corpus transcriptions are not redistributed.
